title: Battle of the Chateauguay
text: The Battle of the Chateauguay was an engagement of the War of 1812. On 26 October 1813, a Canadian and Native force consisting of 1,530 militia and Mohawk warriors from Lower Canada, commanded by Charles de Salaberry, repelled an American force of about 2,600 regulars which was attempting to invade Lower Canada and ultimately attack Montreal. The battle was one of the two battles which caused the Americans to abandon the Saint Lawrence campaign, their major strategic effort in the autumn of 1813.
